mapper.select: SELECT p.POST_ID as postId, p.WS_ID as wsId, p.PROJ_ID as projId, p.TITLE as title, p.USER_ID as userId, u.USER_NAME as writerName, p.VIEW_COUNT as viewCount, p.BOARD_TYPE as boardType, CASE WHEN p.IS_PINNED = 'Y' AND (p.PIN_START_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_START_DT <= SYSDATE) AND (p.PIN_END_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_END_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END as isPinned, TO_CHAR(p.PIN_START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as pinStartDt, TO_CHAR(p.PIN_END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as pinEndDt, CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(p.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END as regDt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPLIES r WHERE r.POST_ID = p.POST_ID) as replyCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID = p.POST_ID) as fileCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ATTACHMENTS a WHERE a.POST_ID = p.POST_ID) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as hasFile, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CONTENT_REACTIONS cr WHERE cr.CONTENT_ID = p.POST_ID AND cr.CONTENT_TYPE = CASE WHEN p.BOARD_TYPE = 'NOTICE' THEN 'NOTICE' ELSE 'BOARD' END AND cr.REACTION_TYPE = 'LIKE') as likeCount FROM BOARD_POSTS p JOIN USERS u ON p.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE p.WS_ID = #{wsId} AND p.BOARD_TYPE = #{boardType} AND p.PROJ_ID IS NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_PINNED = 'Y' AND (p.PIN_START_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_START_DT <= SYSDATE) AND (p.PIN_END_DT IS NULL OR p.PIN_END_DT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.REG_DT DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT R.REPLY_ID, R.POST_ID, R.PARENT_REPLY_ID, R.CONTENT, R.USER_ID, TO_CHAR(R.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT, U.USER_NAME FROM BOARD_REPLIES R JOIN USERS U ON R.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE R.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY NVL(R.PARENT_REPLY_ID, R.REPLY_ID) ASC, CASE WHEN R.PARENT_REPLY_ID IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, R.REG_DT ASC

SELECT CASE WHEN w.OWNER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'OWNER' WHEN UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE UPPER(NVL(wm.WS_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) END FROM WORKSPACES w JOIN WS_MEMBERS wm ON wm.WS_ID = w.WS_ID AND wm.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE w.WS_ID = #{wsId}

SELECT CASE WHEN p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'LEADER' WHEN UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) = 'ADMIN' THEN 'ADMIN' ELSE UPPER(NVL(pm.PROJ_ROLE, 'MEMBER')) END FROM PROJECTS p LEFT JOIN PROJ_MEMBERS pm ON pm.PROJ_ID = p.PROJ_ID AND pm.USER_ID = #{userId} WHERE p.PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND (p.LEADER_ID = #{userId} OR pm.USER_ID = #{userId})
mapper.sql: SELECT br.REPORT_ID, br.CONTENT_TYPE, br.CONTENT_ID, br.REPORTER_ID, reporter.USER_NAME AS REPORTER_NAME, br.REASON, br.DETAIL, br.STATUS, TO_CHAR(br.REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS REG_DT, TO_CHAR(br.PROC_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PROC_DT, procUser.USER_NAME AS PROC_USER_NAME, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.POST_ID ELSE post.POST_ID END AS POST_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.WS_ID ELSE post.WS_ID END AS WS_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.PROJ_ID ELSE post.PROJ_ID END AS PROJ_ID, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.BOARD_TYPE ELSE post.BOARD_TYPE END AS BOARD_TYPE, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.TITLE ELSE post.TITLE END AS TARGET_TITLE, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(reply.CONTENT, '<[^>]*>', '') ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(post.CONTENT, 1000, 1), '<[^>]*>', '') END AS TARGET_CONTENT, CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.REPLY_ID ELSE NULL END AS REPLY_ID, targetUser.USER_NAME AS TARGET_WRITER_NAME FROM BOARD_REPORTS br JOIN USERS reporter ON reporter.USER_ID = br.REPORTER_ID LEFT JOIN USERS procUser ON procUser.USER_ID = br.PROC_USER_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_POSTS post ON br.CONTENT_TYPE IN ('BOARD', 'NOTICE', 'FILE') AND post.POST_ID = br.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPLIES reply ON br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' AND reply.REPLY_ID = br.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_POSTS replyPost ON reply.POST_ID = replyPost.POST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS targetUser ON targetUser.USER_ID = CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.USER_ID ELSE post.USER_ID END

sql.if: AND ( UPPER(NVL(CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN replyPost.TITLE ELSE post.TITLE END, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(reporter.USER_NAME, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(targetUser.USER_NAME, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(br.REASON, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(NVL(br.DETAIL, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR (br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' AND UPPER(NVL(reply.CONTENT, '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') OR (br.CONTENT_TYPE != 'REPLY' AND UPPER(NVL(DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(post.CONTENT, 1000, 1), '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%') )

mapper.select: ORDER BY CASE br.STATUS WHEN 'WAITING' THEN 0 WHEN 'CHECKING' THEN 1 WHEN 'RESOLVED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, br.REG_DT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_REPORTS br JOIN USERS reporter ON reporter.USER_ID = br.REPORTER_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_POSTS post ON br.CONTENT_TYPE IN ('BOARD', 'NOTICE', 'FILE') AND post.POST_ID = br.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_REPLIES reply ON br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' AND reply.REPLY_ID = br.CONTENT_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_POSTS replyPost ON reply.POST_ID = replyPost.POST_ID LEFT JOIN USERS targetUser ON targetUser.USER_ID = CASE WHEN br.CONTENT_TYPE = 'REPLY' THEN reply.USER_ID ELSE post.USER_ID END
